description: The Braunschweig FACE team published sugar-beet experiments from 2001 and 2004 to test growth under ambient and elevated carbon dioxide with high and low nitrogen supply. A cultivar change followed disease in part of the 2001 plots, and the 2004 series added a shading treatment. The dataset includes management, soil, weather, leaf area, biomass, beet yield and composition, carbohydrates and root measurements. Harvard Dataverse’s public dataset API confirmed the named version 1.0 release and CC0 1.0; DataCite lists a 7Z archive, with no price shown. Food-supply modellers can use the observations to validate sugar-beet growth and nitrogen-response simulations under carbon-dioxide scenarios. The two experimental years at one site do not represent all European climates. Disease and cultivar changes matter when comparing years. The archive was not downloaded, so variable-level coverage and file structure remain unchecked. This is related to other FACE crop datasets G4-0572 and G4-0581, but covers sugar beet. No catalogue identity match appeared in the full duplicate scan.
